rules.title: The path is too narrow
rules.source_text: Except as provided in 403.5.2 and 403.5.3, the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum. EXCEPTION: The clear width shall be permitted to be reduced to 32 inches (815 mm) minimum for a length of 24 inches (610 mm) maximum provided that reduced width segments are separated by segments that are 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum in length and 36 inches (915 mm) minimum in width.

rules.title: There is not enough room to turn this corner
rules.source_text: Where the accessible route makes a 180 degree turn around an element which is less than 48 inches (1220 mm) in width, clear width shall be 42 inches (1065 mm) minimum approaching the turn, 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum at the turn and 42 inches (1065 mm) minimum leaving the turn. EXCEPTION: 403.5.2 shall not apply where the clear width at the turn is 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum.

rules.title: There is nowhere to pass another customer
rules.source_text: An accessible route with a clear width less than 60 inches (1525 mm) shall provide passing spaces at intervals of 200 feet (61 m) maximum. Passing spaces shall be either: a space 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum by 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum; or, an intersection of two walking surfaces providing a T-shaped space complying with 304.3.2 where the base and arms of the T-shaped space extend 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum beyond the intersection.

rules.title: There is not enough room to turn around
rules.source_text: 304.3 Size. Turning space shall comply with 304.3.1 or 304.3.2. 304.3.1 Circular Space. The turning space shall be a space of 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter minimum. The space shall be permitted to include knee and toe clearance complying with 306.

rules.title: The doorway is too narrow
rules.source_text: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum. Clear openings of doorways with swinging doors shall be measured between the face of the door and the stop, with the door open 90 degrees.

rules.title: The counter is too high to order from
rules.source_text: 904.4.1 Parallel Approach. A portion of the counter surface that is 36 inches (915 mm) long minimum and 36 inches (915 mm) high maximum above the finish floor shall be provided. A clear floor or ground space complying with 305 shall be positioned for a parallel approach adjacent to the 36 inch (915 mm) minimum length of counter.

rules.title: People pay at the high counter
rules.source_text: 904.4.1 Parallel Approach. A portion of the counter surface that is 36 inches (915 mm) long minimum and 36 inches (915 mm) high maximum above the finish floor shall be provided. Advisory 904.2 Approach. If a cash register is provided at the sales or service counter, locate the accessible counter close to the cash register so that a person using a wheelchair is visible to sales or service personnel and to minimize the reach for a person with a disability.
rules.review_note: 904.2's register sentence is an advisory. The check fires only when a lowered section already meets 904.4.1 and the point of sale still sits on a higher section, which is the fact pattern in Whitaker v. T Rock Inc.

rules.title: There is not enough room to pull up to the counter
rules.source_text: 305.3 Size. The clear floor or ground space shall be 30 inches (760 mm) minimum by 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum. Referenced by 904.4.1, which positions that space for a parallel approach adjacent to the 36 inch minimum length of counter.

rules.title: The way out is blocked
rules.source_text: 1009.1 Accessible means of egress required. Accessible means of egress shall comply with this section; each accessible space is provided with at least one accessible means of egress, and where more than one means is required by 1006.2 or 1006.3, each accessible portion shall be served by the same number. 1009.2 requires each required accessible means of egress to be continuous to a public way and include accessible route elements that in California must comply with 11B-206 and 11B-402.
rules.review_note: This check confirms whether a clear path to the exit exists on the scan, but does not yet evaluate CBC 1005.3/1006.2 sizing, travel distance, or capacity limits.

rules.title: The step at the front door
rules.source_text: 303.2 Vertical. Changes in level of 1/4 inch (6.4 mm) high maximum shall be permitted to be vertical. 303.3 Beveled. Changes in level between 1/4 inch (6.4 mm) high minimum and 1/2 inch (13 mm) high maximum shall be beveled with a slope not steeper than 1:2.

rules.title: The front door handle
rules.source_text: 404.2.7 Door and Gate Hardware. Handles, pulls, latches, locks, and other operable parts on doors and gates shall comply with 309.4. Operable parts of such hardware shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum above the finish floor. 309.4 requires operation with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist.

rules.title: How hard the front door is to open
rules.source_text: 404.2.9 Door and Gate Opening Force. Fire doors shall have a minimum opening force allowable by the appropriate administrative authority. The force for pushing or pulling open a door or gate other than fire doors shall be as follows: (a) Interior hinged doors and gates: 5 pounds (22.2 N) maximum. (b) Sliding or folding doors: 5 pounds (22.2 N) maximum. These forces do not apply to the force required to retract latch bolts or disengage other devices that hold the door or gate in a closed position.

rules.title: The floor and the mats
rules.source_text: 302.1 General. Floor and ground surfaces shall be stable, firm, and slip resistant. 302.2 Carpet. Carpet or carpet tile shall be securely attached and shall have a firm cushion, pad, or backing or no cushion or pad. Carpet or carpet tile shall have a level loop, textured loop, level cut pile, or level cut/uncut pile texture. Pile height shall be 1/2 inch (13 mm) maximum. 302.3 Openings. Openings in floor or ground surfaces shall not allow passage of a sphere more than 1/2 inch (13 mm) diameter.

rules.title: The customer restroom
rules.source_text: 603.2.1 Turning Space. Turning space complying with 304 shall be provided within the room. 604.2 Location. The water closet shall be positioned with a wall or partition to the rear and to one side. The centerline of the water closet shall be 16 inches (405 mm) minimum to 18 inches (455 mm) maximum from the side wall or partition.

rules.title: The room in front of the door
rules.source_text: 404.2.4 Maneuvering Clearances. Minimum maneuvering clearances at doors and gates shall comply with 404.2.4. Maneuvering clearances shall extend the full width of the doorway and the required latch side or hinge side clearance. Table 404.2.4.1 gives the clearance by approach direction and door type; a front approach, pull side, hinged door requires 60 inches perpendicular to the doorway and 18 inches beyond the latch side.
rules.review_note: Table 404.2.4.1 has twelve rows. Each approach direction needs its own entry here before this check ships.

rules.title: Something sticks out into the path
rules.source_text: 307.2 Protrusion Limits. Objects with leading edges more than 27 inches (685 mm) and not more than 80 inches (2030 mm) above the finish floor or ground shall protrude 4 inches (100 mm) maximum horizontally into the circulation path. 307.3 Post-Mounted Objects. Free-standing objects mounted on posts or pylons shall overhang circulation paths 12 inches (305 mm) maximum when located 27 inches (685 mm) minimum and 80 inches (2030 mm) maximum above the finish floor or ground.
rules.review_note: LiDAR misses thin wall-mounted items. This check may only report where coverage shows the wall was observed in the 27 to 80 inch band.

rules.title: Something is out of reach
rules.source_text: 308.2.1 Unobstructed. Where a forward reach is unobstructed, the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low forward reach shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish floor or ground.
rules.review_note: 308 is about operable parts: switches, card readers, bell pulls. A scan gives boxes and does not identify any of them, so this is a request for a photograph rather than a measurement.

rules.title: The tables are the wrong height
rules.source_text: 902.3 Height. The tops of dining surfaces and work surfaces shall be 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum above the finish floor or ground. 226.1 requires that where dining surfaces are provided for the consumption of food or drink, at least 5 percent of the seating spaces and standing spaces at the dining surfaces shall comply with 902.
rules.review_note: 226.1 scopes a share of seats, not every seat. The share and the height are two separate checks and this entry only carries the height.
